author: Reuters
content_snippet:
Korea surpassed $1 trillion in annual exports for the first time Thursday, reaching the milestone at 2:09:38 p.m. as global AI investment boosted demand for semiconductors. It became the fourth country to reach the mark, after the United States, Germany and China. The government projects exports will total about $1.17 trillion this year, but officials warned that AI investment slowdowns, chip-price volatility and trade barriers could threaten momentum.

Containers are stacked at a port in Incheo
summary_en: The South Korean Ministry of Trade, Industry and Resources announced that the nation's annual exports hit $1 trillion for the first time, fueled by robust demand for semiconductors and data center infrastructure driven by global AI investment. While full-year projections reach $1.17 trillion, officials warned that potential slowdowns in AI spending, chip price volatility, and trade barriers remain key risks to future momentum.

paragraphs_zh: 人工智能独角兽 Anthropic PBC 在其创纪录的全球首次公开募股（IPO）中，向英国及欧洲大陆的散户投资者定向发售了总值达11亿美元的股票，创下全球资本市场历史上针对散户的最大规模科技股配售纪录。
彭博社查阅的监管备案文件显示，这家开发了 Claude 聊天机器人的前沿 AI 实验室向英国零售投资者配售了略超360万股股票，并向欧盟、挪威及瑞士的散户配售了近970万股股票。
尽管此前市场对生成式 AI 巨额算力资本开支的可持续性及二级市场震荡有所疑虑，但 Anthropic 及其联合创始人团队依然克服了重重阻力，将最终 IPO 发行价定于推介区间顶端之上，累计募资规模达1073亿美元。公司周四在纽约纳斯达克的正式挂牌使其成为全球首家登陆公开市场的顶级 AI 前沿实验室。
按照每股83美元的发行价计算，Anthropic 分别通过英国本土平台配售和欧洲大陆跨境销售筹集了约3亿美元与8.01亿美元资金。这一零售发售规模显著超过了埃隆·马斯克旗下 SpaceX 此前向英国储蓄者发售的3.64亿美元以及向欧洲大陆散户配售的逾6亿美元纪录。
在英国市场，Anthropic 充分利用了英国创新的公开发行平台监管框架（Public-Offer Platforms Regime），在无需单独编制繁复本地招股说明书的前提下直接对接个人投资者。该笔发售由 RetailBook 投资平台领衔协调，AJ Bell、哈格里夫斯-兰斯当（Hargreaves Lansdown）以及数字银行巨头 Revolut 等经纪商共同承担了散户订单报送与划转。
而在欧洲大陆地区，Anthropic 面向德国、丹麦、芬兰、法国、爱尔兰、荷兰、挪威、西班牙、瑞典和瑞士的散户推出了全欧区域性配售方案，该承销团由包括法国巴黎银行（BNP Paribas SA）、德意志银行（Deutsche Bank AG）和瑞士联合银行（UBS Group AG）在内的欧洲顶级银行集团及 Trade Republic、盛宝银行（Saxo Bank）等数字券商联手护航。

summary_en: Research from Hugging Face indicates that the cost of large-scale document OCR has dropped fivefold over the past 18 months, driven by lightweight model architectures and improved GPU rental efficiencies. content_snippet:

The AI lab has earmarked up to a fifth of its record IPO for individual investors, or nearly $19bn of stock at $83 per share. 联邦调查局（FBI）最新犯罪统计数据显示，去年全美及海外受害者因网络犯罪遭受的经济损失接近210亿美元，同比激增约25%，其中与加密货币洗钱、虚假投资盘和勒索软件直接相关的损失占到总金额的一半以上。

title: America’s AI Chip War Is Heating Up in the Dumbest Possible Ways

author: Louise Matsakis
content_snippet:
This week, the Trump administration made it significantly harder for Chinese companies to access some of the world’s most advanced AI chips. For years, tech firms like Alibaba and ByteDance could rent computing power from data centers overseas, allowing them to use powerful Nvidia chips they were generally prohibited from physically importing into China. This is known as remote access.

But under new plans announced on Monday, overseas data centers that want to provide large amounts of computing
summary_en: The Trump administration has mandated special licensing for overseas data centers providing large-scale computing power to China, effectively closing the 'remote access' loophole. Additional export controls were imposed on Singapore and Malaysia to curb chip smuggling, a move triggered by the scandal involving former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang and his ties to Chinese intelligence assets.

author: Jason Parham
content_snippet:
As generational cohorts go, Gen Z has been saddled with its share of labels. They scarcely have sex, are “quiet quitters” when it comes to office jobs, and, as they avoid traditional partnership, have learned to solomaxx.

Whether these labels are deserved or completely off the mark, what continually connects this unique class of young people is a desire to reconstruct how they think about connection.

In “Friendship in an Online-Offline World: Digital Life, Connection and Wellbeing” researchers
summary_en: A study by Gallup and the Digital Wellness Lab at Boston Children's Hospital surveyed 15,925 youth across 16 countries, finding 33% of Gen Z rely on AI for companionship, peaking at 50% among daily users. While AI fills social gaps, it fails to match the emotional support of in-person bonds, with reliance on digital-only connections correlating with increased loneliness.
